name: WF-445 — Title Clearance → Closing Date, Settlement & Buyer/Seller Coordination Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const contractId=String(b.contractId??'').trim(); const titleOrderId=String(b.titleOrderId??'').trim(); const clearanceEventId=String(b.clearanceEventId??b.eventId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,dealId,contractId,titleOrderId,clearanceEventId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Title Clearance Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const flags=[]; const title=ctx.titleClearance??{}; const dealState=String(ctx.dealState??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase(); if(['closed','cancelled','disputed','dnc','suppressed'].includes(dealState)||ctx.dnc===true||ctx.suppressed===true)flags.push('deal_or_contact_blocked'); if(title.cleared!==true)flags.push('title_not_cleared'); if(title.openIssueCount>0)flags.push('title_issues_unresolved'); const sellerReady=ctx.sellerClosingReady===true; const buyerReady=ctx.buyerClosingReady===true; const fundsReady=ctx.buyerFundsReady===true; const titleCompanyConfirmed=ctx.titleCompanyConfirmed===true; const settlementReady=ctx.settlementStatementReady===true; const purchasePrice=Number(ctx.purchasePrice??0); const assignmentFee=Number(ctx.assignmentFee??0); if(!sellerReady)flags.push('seller_closing_readiness_missing'); if(!buyerReady)flags.push('buyer_closing_readiness_missing'); if(!fundsReady)flags.push('buyer_funds_not_confirmed'); if(!titleCompanyConfirmed)flags.push('title_company_not_confirmed'); if(!settlementReady)flags.push('settlement_statement_not_ready'); if(!(purchasePrice>0))flags.push('purchase_price_missing'); const proposedDate=String(ctx.proposedClosingDate??ctx.requestedClosingDate??'').trim(); const confirmedDate=String(ctx.confirmedClosingDate??'').trim(); const closingDate=confirmedDate||proposedDate; const dateValid=Boolean(closingDate); if(!dateValid)flags.push('closing_date_missing'); const ready=flags.length===0; const decision=ready?'coordinate_final_closing':'hold_closing_coordination'; const nextAction=ready?'confirm_closing_date_and_issue_final_settlement_package':'resolve_closing_readiness_requirements'; const coordinationPackage={titleOrderId:input.titleOrderId,closingDate:closingDate||null,titleCompany:{id:ctx.titleCompanyId??null,name:ctx.titleCompanyName??null,contact:ctx.titleCompanyContact??null},buyer:{id:ctx.buyerId??null,name:ctx.buyerName??null,closingContact:ctx.buyerClosingContact??null},seller:{id:ctx.sellerId??null,name:ctx.sellerName??null,closingContact:ctx.sellerClosingContact??null},financials:{purchasePrice:purchasePrice||null,assignmentFee:assignmentFee||null,closingCosts:Number(ctx.closingCosts??0)||0},requiredClosingItems:ctx.requiredClosingItems??[]}; const idempotencyKey='wf445:'+input.leadId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.titleOrderId+':'+input.clearanceEventId; return [{json:{...input,closingCoordinationDecision:{status:ready?'ready':'pending',decision,nextAction,closingDate:closingDate||null,dateSource:confirmedDate?'confirmed':'proposed',coordinationPackage,flags,requiresHumanReview:!ready,confidenceScore:ready?97:25},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Coordinates final closing date, settlement readiness, buyer/seller readiness and title-company handoff after title clearance. Production use requires verified InsulaCRM closing schema, title/closing provider integrations, jurisdiction-specific closing requirements and accounting/settlement controls.
